brief:
The Israeli military said a Hezbollah fighter shot and wounded two soldiers from the Golani Brigade during an exchange in the Beaufort Castle area of southern Lebanon, Shehab Wire reported. The Israeli army confirmed the incident occurred in the region but did not immediately disclose the soldiers' conditions or the circumstances that led to the clash.

The shooting marked another cross-border exchange in an area that has seen repeated military friction between Israeli forces and Hezbollah in recent months. The Beaufort Castle zone sits along the Israel-Lebanon border and has been a flashpoint for armed clashes between the two sides.
